g=[[0]*20 for _ in range(20)]
ones=[(2,6),(3,19),(4,5),(7,1),(8,19),(12,9),(17,13),(19,15)]
for r in range(2,9):
    for c in range(9,16): g[r][c]=2
# rays per row from rectangle edges, stop before aligned 1s
for r in range(2,9):
    blockers=[c for rr,c in ones if rr==r]
    left=max([c for c in blockers if c<9], default=-1)
    right=min([c for c in blockers if c>15], default=20)
    for c in range(left+1,9): g[r][c]=2
    for c in range(16,right): g[r][c]=2
# vertical rays
for c in range(9,16):
    blockers=[r for r,cc in ones if cc==c]
    up=max([r for r in blockers if r<2], default=-1)
    down=min([r for r in blockers if r>8], default=20)
    for r in range(up+1,2): g[r][c]=2
    for r in range(9,down): g[r][c]=2
for r,c in ones:g[r][c]=1
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in g))
